summary: Configured node1 with persistent firewalld rules permitting SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections. The policy survived a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Enabled an explicit REJECT target on the public zone.
Retained SSH and added TCP/8080 as the only inbound allowances.
Verified connections to ports 22 and 8080 while a listening service on 8081 was rejected.
Restarted node1 and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Repeated policy and functional checks after restart.
Removed all temporary test listeners, interfaces, and namespaces.

evidence.requirement: Persistent firewall permits SSH and TCP/8080 while rejecting unrelated inbound connections
evidence.summary: Runtime and persistent firewalld policy contains only SSH and TCP/8080 with an explicit REJECT target. External-style testing connected successfully to ports 22 and 8080, while a live listener on port 8081 was rejected.

Pre-restart boot ID was 33b0e84c-4dd1-406a-8f89-2e8ceca97bd6. The reboot was acknowledged, and node1 returned with boot ID 62074a07-3258-4a62-b71e-fd814a8f0d4c. Firewalld and SSH recovered, the persistent rules remained active, and post-restart connection tests again allowed 22/8080 and rejected 8081.
